description: Use when the user asks about the planes themselves — "which tail numbers have Starlink?", "which aircraft types are equipped?". Returns United Airlines tail numbers, aircraft types, operators, and install dates (default 50 most recent; pass limit up to 500). Not for finding flights — use search_starlink_flights for that.

fleet.description: Filter to only express (regional) or mainline aircraft.

limit.description: Maximum number of aircraft to return (default 50).

name: list_starlink_aircraft
title: List Starlink aircraft
